flows:
Navigate to https://app.uniswap.org/swap then Do not connect a wallet or sign anything.
Never press 'Swap', 'Review', 'Confirm Swap', 'Approve' or 'Connect'.
On the Uniswap app swap page, click the token drop-down in the 'Sell' section.
Check that a list of tokens appears, then select any token from that list.
Check that the selected token now appears as the token in the 'Sell' section.
Next, click the token drop-down in the 'Buy' section.
Assert that a list of tokens appears along with network names or a network selector.
